scripts.install:all: npm --prefix apps/desktop install && npm --prefix apps/extension install
scripts.install:ci: npm --prefix apps/desktop ci && npm --prefix apps/extension ci
scripts.build: npm --prefix apps/extension run build && npm --prefix apps/desktop run tauri build
scripts.build:web: npm --prefix apps/desktop run build && npm --prefix apps/extension run build
scripts.lint: npm --prefix apps/desktop run lint && npm --prefix apps/extension run lint && npm run lint:rust
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix apps/desktop run typecheck && npm --prefix apps/extension run typecheck
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration && npm run test:regression && npm run test:rust
scripts.test:regression: npm --prefix apps/desktop run test:regression && cargo test --manifest-path apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.toml regression_bug
scripts.qa: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build:web
scripts.qa:full: npm run qa && npm run test:e2e
